correctness.rationale: Trace and the principal minors give λ₊+λ₋=2S and λ₊λ₋=3Q. From the two spectral projectors on the complement of the constant vector, an edge w has heat entry (1−exp(−qt))/3 + B_w(exp(−pt)−exp(−qt)), with p=λ₊^α, q=λ₋^α and B_w=(λ₋/3−w)/(λ₊−λ₋). The identity (S²−3Q)−(S−3w)²=−3(w−w′)(w−w″) orders the cut λ₋/3 between the least and second-least weights, with equality at the least exactly for a tied minimum. Thus only a unique weakest edge can be negative; the repeated-eigenvalue equal-weight case has a single nontrivial exponential and is strictly positive for t>0. For weakest-edge B=B_m>0 set A=B+1/3. Its derivative is exp(−qt)[Aq−Bp exp(−(p−q)t)], whose bracket is strictly increasing. It is nonnegative at zero exactly for α≤α*, and then strictly positive for t>0, including at the order endpoint. At α=1 the derivative at zero is m>0. Above α* the derivative has exactly one zero, with the stated logarithmic time, and k(t) rises thereafter to 1/3 from a strict negative minimum; it crosses zero once at the stated implicit root. Diagonals are positive by the spectral projections; row sums are one, so the only negative pair gives the claimed row norm amplification, whose unique peak precedes recovery. The equal-stronger family gives eigenvalues 3−2ε,3 and ratio 3 in the numerator of α*. For fixed C>1 the other family has λ₋=3−3δ/2+O(δ²) and λ₊=2C+1−δ/2+O(δ²), giving numerator log(1/δ)+log(4(C−1)/3)+O(δ) and the stated denominator up to O(δ). The profile, not a separately stated height formula, gives the peak height. The script verify_triangle.py was read, not executed; its floating-point checks do not establish the quantifiers in the theorem.

value.rationale: An explicit all-order and all-time positivity test on the smallest complete network where superunit powers can produce transient negative heat. The exact row-norm profile quantifies the failure of contractivity, and the two conductance limits show how rapidly the critical order becomes inaccessible near a tie in two natural regimes. The contribution is confined to these quantitative weighted-triangle results, not to the already overlapping generic occurrence of a recovery interval.
